name: DJ Andy
bio: I have been on SL for over 15 years and DJing for over 14 years on SL, I Love all types of music.
The two things I love most about SL is Music and the silly side of SL.
My Favorite quote is :
May those who love us, love us; and those who don't love us, may God turn their hearts; and if He can't turn their hearts, may he turn their ankles so we'll know them by their limping

name: DJ Candi
bio: Somebody once said to me my soul has the shape of a music note. There is a lot of truth to that I suppose. I was so crazy about music already when I was a kid my parents gave me a record player when i was 6 years old, as I always wanted to use my dad's which was very expensive. For my birthdays I wanted to have records and not toys. I went to music theory courses and played flute and oboe in several ensembles. I have respect for all music artists in any genre. I like many genres from death metal and classic music to catchy pop songs and vocal trance. I like to share my love for music with others. What is better than to have nice talks with friends and learn to know new people with some nice music.

name: DJ Jasmine
bio: Hello, my name is DJ Jasmine I have been in Secondlife for over 14 years and have been Djing for over 6 years.

I love to play all genres and really love to DJ at Muddy's Music Cafe. Playing upbeat and fun dance music that getseveryone movin' and groovin' is my favorite. I also have a passion for interacting with the crowd and playing requests for all the listeners I have been so fortunate to have some great hard working hosts to be by my side during my sets and to all of them I say thank you !

I have other interests in Secondlife including wrestling, football, weddings planning & modeling, which I have been involved in for many years. I feel I am well rounded with my interests and hobbies and take full advantage of what Secondlife has to offer.

I would like to thank Bridget for allowing me the opportunity to entertain all the people at Muddys and on Muddys Radio every week. And thank everyone that comes to support me during my sets and also all of you who come to support Muddys, because you are what makes Muddys possible Thank you !

name: DJ Nettie
bio: Hey everyone! I’m DJ Nettie, and I’m excited to be part of the Muddy’s Music Cafe family!

I’m an energetic, easy-going DJ who loves creating a place where people can kick back, relax, have fun, dance, laugh, and simply enjoy themselves. For me, music isn’t just something you hear—it’s something you feel and share.

My absolute favorite era of music is 1970–1989. I simply can’t get enough of that old-school sound! There’s something special about the music from those years—the melodies, the memories, the energy, and those songs that can take you right back to a certain time and place. While I love exploring different music, you can always count on my heart belonging to those classic years.

I’ve been DJing for about two years, with a little break along the way, and I’ve discovered that I truly love being behind the decks. I love finding songs, putting sets together, and watching people enjoy the music I’m playing.

I’ve only been at Muddy’s Music Cafe for about two months, but honestly, it didn’t take long for me to feel like I had found my home. The people, the atmosphere, and the love for music here make Muddy’s a special place to be.

One of my favorite things about DJing is being able to share the music I love to hear with other people. If a song makes me smile, brings back a memory, gets my feet moving, or simply puts me in a good mood, I want to share that feeling with everyone around me.

So when you see DJ Nettie on the board, come on in, grab a drink, find your favorite spot, and turn up the music! Whether you want to dance, relax, reminisce, or just hang out with friends, I’m here to help make your time at Muddy’s a fun one.
Music, memories, good vibes, and a whole lot of fun—that’s what DJ Nettie is all about! 🎧🎶💃🕺 Come join me, and let’s make some musical memories together

name: DJ Pretty Poison
bio: My name is Pretty Poison and I am a DJ at Muddy's Music Cafe.
I've been a lover of most music as long as i can remember and I love to talk. (giggles)

I've been a DJ for about 2 years now. A very good friend of mine who is an amazing DJ himself, Decker Darkthief, taught me how to DJ. Well after that I fell in love with Djing. I get the best of both worlds, the music and the VIPs. They love the music I play and that to me is the best reward a DJ can ask for. I truly enjoy Djing at Muddy's Music Cafe and appreciate the opportunity to be able to do so.
Thank you for taking the time to read this,

name: DJ Twstd
bio: Aloha, I am DJ Twstd in Second Life residing in Oahu for over 18 years.
I love to do many things in Second Life but my most favorite thing to do is DJ at Muddy's Music Cafe. Music has always been my life and I love sharing great tunes when I DJ a set.
I went to broadcasting school in RL but never pursued a career in it, so being able to DJ at Muddy's lets me relive a long time dream of mine.

name: DJ BECS
bio: I’m DJ BECS, from Scotland, and I’m always looking to have a good time, play good music, and have a laugh along the way. I love exploring new places and meeting new people, especially in SL, where every set feels like a new adventure.

I’ve been DJing in real life for a few years now, and bringing that passion into SL has been an amazing experience. I started DJing at Muddys in December 2025, and it’s quickly become a place that feels like home. For me, it’s not just about the music — it’s about the vibes, the people, and the moments we create together on the dancefloor.
Thanks to everyone who’s been part of the journey so far. Let’s keep the music loud, the laughs flowing, and the good times rolling.

name: DJ DLuv
bio: DJ D-Luv, Spinning since 2014 and DJing at Muddy's for 5 years. D-Luv taking you from the 70's to todays in Pop, Rock, and total 80's nerd. The blonde ambition from California, Known as Mr. Giggles. Always a fresh warm highlight to your day.

name: DJ John
bio: I grew up constantly around music and at age 9 I played my first professional event as a piano player and from that point on it was nearly an every weekend thing. By age 12 I was playing 7 different instruments as well as writing and singing and became part of a family based show band. At 14, I started working as a DJ at a roller skating rink on Sundays and at 16 became an assistant technical engineer for a large broadcasting company in my hometown near Chicago.

Between the band and the DJ events there was barely any time for a normal life or school or much else. At age 25 I traded the musical instruments for a mixing console and started doing sound and lighting work for bands and theatrical events. I have designed and built 7 different broadcast facilities that are still on the air in 3 states as well as 3 recording studios and in my early 30's became a full time broadcast music programming and engineering consultant with a specialty in transmitting and studio audio systems. At 36, I traded that for medical electronics but still continued to work nightclubs as a DJ or karaoke operator on weekends until I was 56. I came to Second Life when I was 50 specifically because of the clubs and the performances and I have explored all this grid and a few others have had to offer.

I started at Muddy's in March 2011 which was also my very first SL club and it has been an amazing 10-year run. It's unique when a group of people can come together from all over the world and do what we do to keep going and I can speak for all of us and say we are so grateful that you have been here to entertain and keep coming back and we all have met and made many friends here. It's a crazy, slightly dysfunctional family behind the scenes, but we always pull together when the going gets tough because as it is said, the show must go on. For myself it's always been about the music and entertainment, to make someone laugh, smile and forget about real life for a while. I see no end in sight anytime soon.
Thank you for being here and making it possible to do what we do every day.

name: DJ Oliver
bio: Relatively new to DJing, DJ Oliver has been a music lover from his early teens. He has a love for pop and soft-rock from the 1960s forward, as well as nearly any genre of music.
Appreciates the impact that music can have not only a person's mood, but also on a person's life and tries to make each set both powerful and memorable.

name: DJ Robbie
bio: Hi im DJ Robbie a DJ in second life for 14 years i love fast cars and regularly go Racing at weekends my fave food is pasta anything with pasta lol im 50 ish RL i love to play music at Muddys and make all the vips happy currently working 2am and 2pm shifts

name: DJ Vixen
bio: DJ VIXEN, an experienced SL DJ since 2012, has worked at countless venues all over SL since entering the club scene shortly after her Rez Date. Vixen has called Muddy's Music Cafe her home since 2019. "It's all about the music for me and making people smile and laugh." She can play anything from Motown to Country to current Top Pop, but 70s and 80s tunes are her favorite. Her fans have given her a warning label of "Known to make your feet hurt, booty shake and can't help but sing along... 24/7 non stop movin' and groovin'".

Vixen is also passionate about fund raising for American Cancer Society. You will often find her at Relay For Life events around the Grid. In 2023 she had the privilege of receiving an invitation to join the Relay Radio Team and became an On Air Host during Relay Weekend.

name: DJ Beary
bio: I've been spinning tunes in Second Life for over 16 years now. My journey began with WinAmp and a solid collection of my personal CDs — and from there, the love for DJing only grew. Over time, I transitioned to SAM Broadcaster, expanding not just my musical library but also my technical skills.

Throughout the years, I've had the privilege of playing everything from Rock, Pop, and Country to themed sets and elegant ballroom music. Some may remember my time at Muddy's Country — and now, I'm thrilled to say I'm back, bringing the energy and passion to Muddy’s Music Café.

Along the way, I’ve been lucky to work with some incredibly talented DJs who helped shape the DJ I am today. In turn, I've shared my knowledge — especially when it comes to troubleshooting and teaching others how to navigate SAM Broadcaster and now, Virtual DJ, my current setup of choice.

It's been a wild ride with its fair share of ups and downs, but one thing has remained constant: my love for music and the community around it. I’m proud to be back home with the amazing Muddy’s family — and I can’t wait to see you all around the club

name: DJ Dazz
bio: With 19 years on the Second Life grid, DJ Dazz is a seasoned, high-energy DJ known for his wide-ranging music style and crowd-pleasing sets. he did dj venues like Blackhearts, R.M.S. Titanic,Charleston Lace, Phat Cats,Amarosa, Big Daddys, and Muddy’s, DJ Dazz is known for delivering unforgettable vibes across every era and genre. In May 2024, he was proudly inducted into the DJ Hall of Fame, honoring his lasting impact and dedication to the craft. Fun, respected, and always in the groove—Dazz brings the party, wherever he plays

name: DJ Legendary
bio: My passion is music, and DJing ,when I see the people enjoy my party, I am the most happiest man in sl. I like very much various tunes, but my big preference is for pop, and soft rock. In the years I have been in SL I have been some years off SL, but I have always enjoy each single party I did. Music is life, and a true universal language that arrives to each ones heart and mind with singular vibrate and humor ,for each tune there can be a memory, a feeling and much more. Love and be loved from music

name: DJ Otter
bio: I Started as a Host and now I am a DJ here at Muddy's. Early Morning shift you can come see me. I do love to squeeze in my boy bands in when i can and i know we all love them even if you don't want to admit it out loud for others to hear. But you should come see me when i am on the stage and get to know me i'm a fun loving girl.
Been here at Muddy's for a while now and can say that the people here from the Staff to the Amazing VIPs are friendly and i love be around them, they make you feel like home.
So come on down and See the Club and make new friends we would be happy to see you with us.
*hugs* and much love to all of you.

name: DJ Thor
bio: I just love playing music and Muddy's is definitely one of the best venues in SL to do just that and have a great time as well. Mostly enjoying 90's, 80's and older tunes - basically anything that has some rock to it. Aside from dj-ing I love doing SL photography, machinima (SL video), flirting and to tp-around exploring the wonders of the meta-verse.
After all these years I'm on SL to simply relax, getting to know people and have fun doing things I enjoy. It's like I always say while dj-ing: all requests are welcome, even the musical ones

name: DJ Beragon
bio: DJ Beragon is from Texas and enjoys a good melody and a good beat. And a tasty guitar riff. He wishes good vibes and good fortune to everyone.

name: DJ Elyas
bio: My musical journey began when I was 5, my mom introduced me to Elvis Presley, Johnny Cash, Carl Perkins, Chuck Berry. At 10 I was exposed to Jazz music greats Miles Davis, John Coltrane, Buddy Rich.

I started doing jazz public radio at 20, collage party’s, even weddings receptions. At 21 I had the privilege of being a side kick for a local rock station. Music has always been a part of my life. I enjoy all genres of music one can relate to a song, find inspiration. I have been a Second Life Dj for 3 years at various clubs. Being at Muddys Cafe with the best team in Second life is truly amazing and I look forward to being a part of Muddys amazing team and family for years to come. My motto I like to hear what you like to hear

name: DJ Lilith
bio: hi hi I am a Dj and sometimes host at Muddy's Music Cafe!

I have been a host for over a decade in sl as well as a Dj for the last 5 yrs or so. I love with music. I mean that I wake to music in my head, I work with it and I sleep to it. I am a Happy joyful fun loving person and try to bring joy to others through my sets at Muddy's.
I believe that Music makes the world a better place for us all!

name: DJ Perci
bio: I started working as a DJ in Secondlife back in 2009. I got started because I have love to listen to music and have a deep desire to entertain. Throughout the years, I have played a variety of venues and have rubbed elbows with some of the best in the business like all the Dj's and Hosts at Muddys. I look forward to meeting all of Muddys VIP's and making your stay at Muddys a pleasant and entertaining time. See Ya at The Show.

name: DJ Toohey
bio: Originally from the UK and now calling Australia home, Toohey has always been a bit of a radio nerd at heart.

He started DJing back in 2009, and over the years that journey has taken him through Second Life, real-world clubs and pubs, weddings, commercial gigs and even FM radio. Eventually he hung up the headphones and retired from DJing altogether. Or at least, that was the plan.
Then came Muddy's.

What started as dipping a toe back into DJing quickly reignited the spark. These days, a Toohey set tends to feel as much like a radio show as a traditional DJ set, with jingles, features, audience interaction, questionable humour and probably far more audio equipment than anyone reasonably needs.

Toohey's taste in music is pretty broad, but he's always had a soft spot for a great pop record, a big chorus and those songs you haven't heard in years but somehow still know every word to. He's just as interested in finding something new as rediscovering something forgotten, and doesn't believe the next song always has to make perfect sense after the last one.

For Toohey, though, it's always been about the people. Whether you're dancing in the club or listening along on the radio, you're part of the show. Requests, opinions, challenges and a little audience mischief are always encouraged, and everyone is welcome to get involved. The best sets aren't something Toohey performs at an audience. They're something everyone in the room creates together.

Behind the stream, Toohey is an unapologetic technology and audio geek, forever tinkering with something, experimenting with the sound, or finding another piece of equipment he absolutely definitely needs.

name: Alex
bio: My name is Alex, and I’ve been a host in Second Life for 13 years.
I spent a long time looking for a place I could truly call home, and I found that special place at Muddy’s.
I’ve been part of the Muddy’s family since October 2025, and along the way, I’ve found so much more than a place to host, I’ve found a family, a community, and a home

name: BLU
bio: I have been a Muddy's host for a few years. Hosting at Muddy's is a new experience almost every day. The VIP's can make you laugh and smile, Like anything, it has its trials and tribulations but in return it offers fun and new friendships . Come see what its all about :)

name: Evey
bio: Hello! I'm Evey! I love music and I love dancing. I used to listen to Muddy's radio and think I'd love to host there cause the music was awesome.
After many months of thinking about it, In February 2026 I sent my application. I joined Muddy's in March 2026 and I fell in love with the place!

It wasn't just about good music and awesome dances. Everything around was great! The Owner, the hosts, the DJ's. All were friendly, supportive and welcoming. The atmosphere was great, and I love to be in a place with soul and Life!

I'm happy to be here and I love talking to people, getting to know them and making them feel welcomed and heard. They are not just people dancing, they are part of my life here and it's nice to see them having a good time, whether I'm chatting, cheering them up or sharing a laugh.
I could say a thousand things about what I like, but it's too much, so in short: I love music, dancing, learning, chatting about everything and sharing good jokes.

name: Jenny
bio: Hey there, this is Jenny , one of the newest members here at the Muddies family.

I am living proof that regardless of any sl hud technical mishaps that may happen to you, smiling through it will take you far. So dont be surprised if Im hosting and all of a sudden i turn into ruth looking like a clay formation, its just how I roll lol. I love cutting it up with people and to make you smile and laugh.
Sl can be really hard and even lonely at times but we here at Muddies care about our VIPs, old and new, and welcome you as a part of the family!
I look forward to meeting you all! Jenny Sugarsmacks

name: Kelly
bio: Kelly Kingmaker, from San Francisco, CA.
Hosting for the last 9 years. Very chatty, very caring, and loves my time on SL.

name: Nubis
bio: Hello there, my name is Nubis but my close friends call me Nubs. I'm excited to say i got the honor to become part of the Muddy's family.
I enjoy grooving with my new found family at Muddy's to great music and get to know and help our VIPs.
when im not hosting i enjoy spending my time exploring and finding new adventures in sl, i also enjoy taking pictures and playing games cheesy being my favorite.
I enjoy meeting new people and getting to know different cultures.

name: Teresa
bio: Hi. My name is Teresa and as of August 2026, I am one of the newer Hostesses at Muddys. I have loved Muddys for ages and listened to the Muddy’s Radio for a long time at my SL home and at my hair business. I first got involved with Muddy’s as a merchant because I loved to play Muddy’s radio at my store. That is how I got to know the owner, Bridget Hammill.

Several times I thought about how much fun it would be to a Hostess here at Muddy’s, but figured a fantastic club like Muddy’s wouldn’t want an inexperienced hostess like me… I mean I did host for about 6 months at a small club -- but that was like 13 or 14 years ago.

Then I heard that Muddy’s was actively hiring. So with fear and trepidation, I let Bridget know I was interested. I half expected her to politely brush me off. But instead she and the whole team made a place for me, answered my how-to questions, and welcomed me into the family.

It has been a great experience being part of the Muddy’s Team – I really enjoy people and I love the music -- so I took to hostessing like a hand to a glove. I have to confess that I am having the time of my life on stage with the fantastic Djs, great music and wonderful VIPs! I just want our club guests to have as much fun there as I do!!

name: Amfie
bio: I'm Amfie from Scotland, and I've been hosting for over three years. Hosting has brought me wonderful experiences and connections.
Since July 2025, I've hosted at Muddy’s, where the owner, staff, and VIPs have all made me feel welcome.
Dancing has been my lifelong passion, and music is its perfect companion. I love chatting and helping others—it makes life more meaningful.
Hosting combines my love for dancing, music, and connecting with people.

name: Belona
bio: Even though I am new to Second Life I am loving every minute of it specially with my family here at MUDDY'S. I have never felt so welcome and comfortable within a work type environment even though I can't really call it work. How can work be this much fun !!!!

I have an intense love for people, loving, laughter and entertainment is something that I live for. With me, what you see is what you get and I can be a crazy handful at times but I promise it will always be FUN !!!!!!!
I WILL BE YOUR RESIDENT CHATTERBOX & CLASS CLOWN!!!!!!!!!!!
Come over and party with us when I'm hosting!
Love, Cheers and Peace.

name: Heather
bio: I love to host at Muddy's Music Cafe - the VIPs are awesome as I love seeing familiar names as well as new ones - the music is always great and I enjoy trying to keep upbeat and keep the party moving along - thank you Muddy's VIPs for always making my hosting experience awesome - love you all - Heather

name: Jillian
bio: Jillian is from IL USA. On sl, she loves riding motorcycles and playing board games at the Muddy's Mingle sim.She loves attending Real Life Bible Fellowship on Sundays and working at Muddy's as a hostess. In real life, Jillian likes painting, jigsaw puzzles, and slow drives through a nearby wildlife refuge birdwatching. Jillian really likes butterflies and flowers. Jillian is a proud cat mom, to a long haired toroiseshell cat named Callie.

name: Lauren
bio: I came to SL originally in 2009 and one of my very first hostessing jobs was at Muddys! I've been part of the Muddys family off and on since then (as life would allow) and am excited to be once more! There's no place in Second Life like Muddys. The people, the atmosphere, the music, the friendly faces make it one of my favorite places to spend time and have fun!

I love hostessing because it gives me a chance to connect with people, get to know them, and hopefully spread a little happiness into their lives while they are in the club. Kindness is everything and so many people can use that smiling face or warm greeting that we give as hosts and hostesses. It is my honor to be able to do that at Muddy's!

name: Samantha
bio: I showed up to Muddy’s a beautiful mess~lost in Second Life, with hair accidentally attached to my elbow and shoes stuck in the floor. I didn’t know what I was doing, but somehow, Muddy’s knew what I needed. The music reached me first. Then came the laughter, the one~liners from VIPs, the warmth from DJs and hosts who made me feel like I’d always belonged.

In a world that can feel loud and pixelated, Muddy’s was a soft place to land. It cracked something open~reminding me that even in digital spaces, connection is real, and kindness matters. Now, as a host, I get to offer that same experience to others. Whether you’re brand new or just feeling a little lost, know there’s always room for you here. Crooked dances, broken AOs, full hearts~we welcome it all.

name: Victoria
bio: Hola! I’m Victoria Lionheart, and you’ll find me hosting here at Muddy’s Music Café.

I joined Muddy’s because it’s one of those rare places in Second Life that truly feels like home. I love greeting everyone with a smile, keeping the energy flowing, and making sure no one ever feels like a stranger.

Music has always been a big part of who I am—it connects people, sets the mood, and makes every day a little brighter. Hosting lets me share that joy while meeting amazing people from all over the world.
So come by on Thursday mornings, grab a coffee, and let’s make some great memories together at Muddy’s!

name: Annie
bio: I am so proud to be, and absolutely love being, a host here. You can usually find me on Mondays & Wednesdays at 4am slt. plus on Tuesdays at 6am slt. I have been hosting in Second Life since May 2010; it was not too long after that when I was signed up to Muddy's and have been here ever since!

I love chatting to people! I have a host of RL and SL stories to tell when things get quiet. I love being able to help newer guests and members of our wonderful cafe in any way I can. Some need 'dancing tuition', some need ideas and some just need someone to share their joys and troubles. It's a wonderful thing to be able to do this in any life.

Why not come to Muddy's and find us for yourself? We are very much a Muddy's family so be prepared to love us and fall in love with the fabulous musical world that is Muddy's Cafe - any time of your day or night!

name: Corvy
bio: I arrived in SL more than 11 years ago as a wide-eyed newbie. Muddy’s Music Café was one of the first clubs I visited, and I kept coming back because of the great atmosphere.
In 2022 I made the transition from VIP to Muddy’s Host and it was like stepping into a comfortable pair of slippers. Suddenly the music and trivia collected over the years had meaning!

I love being a host - it is really nice to see people you know, to start a good chat, share music and memories, and “hear” the answering smiles in someone’s words. This is what makes a job as a Muddy’s host so rewarding, that connection with words and music!
So, when you have some time, come on down to Muddy’s, one of the friendliest PG clubs in SL, join in the fun and “Be Yourself, everyone else is taken!” (Oscar Wilde)

name: JP
bio: I have nearly 14 years hosting experience but I now work exclusively at Muddy's Music Cafe and have done so since August, 2024.
Muddy's more than a club, it is home and I work with some of the most talented staff in sl.
Staff comes from many different countries but we all unite with love of music under the Muddy's Banner.

name: Kaisa
bio: I've worked at Muddy's since Valentines Day 2025 I've found somewhere i fit in whilst still expressing my differences without fear of judgement or persecution.
Muddy's gave me a home when i didn't have one, and i just love the people, both staff and VIP's, everyone is so friendly and welcoming.
I love how music draws people together. No matter what your tastes, there's something for everybody at Muddy's.

name: Life Suki
bio: Hello! My name is Life Suki!

I am an artist and art gallery owner in SL where I spend most of my time, and I just love to be part of the Muddy's family as host! Everyone is so friendly and fun :) The music is great and the DJs are amazing!
I love that you can meet people from all over the world and create new connections. I am always happy to help, so come visit Muddy's!
Love, Life

name: Sassy Mercury
bio: I'm fun loving and love to meet people. Love that I got a chance to Host at Muddy's.
Been Working with SL Birthday over 10 years. Probably seen me at the stages where, dj's and live singers are. That's very rewarding also.
Love helping people...I do that in second life and real life. Music has always been a love of mine. Not to thrilled over country though..hehehe...
Love working with everyone. Also once you around me long you will find out I love to talk also...haha..
GO Muddy's....

name: Wild
bio: Crazy and bratty red head with many years in the SL entertainment business as a Hostess or DJ since Nov 2007. Never know what may pop into mind when good chat is going on to engage the crowd with. At Muddy's I call it home and have now since Mar 23, 2018 . Drop in and visit us we always have room for one more.

name: Aria
bio: Hi everyone - my name is Aria, and I'm from the West Coast, USA. I've been in SL since 2007, and have been hosting since about 2010 in various venues. I've been coming to Muddy's on and off for years, and was so excited when I heard a 'staff wanted' ad in December 2024 and was hired on.

Hosting allows me to meet so many new and interesting people from all over the world, and I really enjoy all the talented DJs that we have at Muddy's. I love how music brings us together and lets us share the moment.

When not hosting, I enjoy going to live music performances, art installations, playing games & puzzles, and exploring all the strange and wonderful things that SL has to offer. I look forward to seeing you at Muddy's!

name: Daryion

I love meeting new and interesting people and listening to awesome music. Each set is a new experience and I always have a lot of fun with plenty of laughs.

name: JayMarie

I look at the staff and VIPs as my extended SL family.

name: Kate
bio: A little about Kate:

Kate is a part of my RL person. I respect her accordingly. She has values that I abide by in RL and in SL. She loves to host for the greatest venues. Her music interests in order of preference....Blues, most definitely blues, smooth jazz, R&B, Funk, Any type of Cafe and Zen music, Classic Rock, Bridget trusted this hostess with her heart and I vowed to do my best. My avi changes from time to time but my heart and soul remain the same.
Peace and Love from Kate

name: Sophia
bio: I came to SL over 17 years ago and I still have fun and love it I came to Muddy's over 4 years ago as a guest , it is a fun and safe place to hang out. One day the owner said I should be a host here and I through she was joking . but now I host here and do fill-ins .. I enjoy it at Muddy's I can make the guest laugh and they do the same for me. Its wonderful to meet new people and spread a little joy in this world we call SL

name: Zaya
bio: Hey there! I’m Zaya — your quick-witted, sarcastic, happy Canadian with a deep love for music and meeting new people. If there’s a good tune playing, you can bet I’m dancing in my chair like it’s a full-blown concert.

I'm pretty sure my love for Muddys began on day one. What started as a casual stop while sim-hopping quickly turned into something much more meaningful. To me, Muddys is more than a venue. It’s home away from home — a cozy, familiar corner of the grid where laughter is easy, friendships grow fast, and the tunes hit just right. I'm honored to share the stage with some of the most amazing DJ's I've ever heard!
Music isn’t just something you listen to — You should feel it, move with it, and let it set the tone for every day.

If I’m not hosting, I’m probably out on the floor dancing next to you like we’re at the same concert. If I’m missing from the crowd? I’m decorating, exploring gorgeous sims, laughing with friends, or doing what I do best… shopping.
Laugh, joke, and dance — Come hang with me!
See you soon! 💖
